Aditya Gupta

L E A D S O F T W A R E D E V E L O P E R

PROFESSIONAL OVERVIEW

8800282414

adityagupta05530@gmail.com

Delhi, India

linkedin.com/in/aadityaa/

I am a results-driven software engineering professional with a strong background in web applications, particularly in developing scalable microservices using Java and Spring Boot. I excel in leading teams through effective collaboration and problem-solving, ensuring high performance and reliability in my projects. My dedication to continuous improvement is demonstrated through my commitment to documentation and quality assurance.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Staff Engineer | Associate Staff Engineer | Senior Engineer

Nagarro, India 09/2021 - Present

Developed scalable microservices & RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot, enhancing microservice communication and system modularity. Boosted API performance through load testing, achieving a 50% improvement in response time.

Designed and implemented platform tenant architecture enabling secure multi- tenant onboarding, role-based access control, and isolated data storage across clients.

Created API documentation with Swagger and Confluence, speeding up team onboarding by 25%.

Conducted end-to-end API testing for automation tenants, including regression and manual testing.

Troubleshoot production issues and executed bug fixes, reducing downtime by 30%.

Software Developer Newgen Software, India 02/2021 - 09/2021

Developed and deployed 20+ RESTful APIs and microservices in Spring Boot, resulting in a 40% improvement in system response times.

Acted as a key liaison between onsite and offshore teams, managing end-to-end project lifecycle from requirement gathering to production delivery.

Designed a robust token-based authentication system to secure internal APIs, ensuring compliance with security standards.

Wrote comprehensive unit tests with Junit (coverage 90%) and supported integration with QA teams.

Associate Software Engineer

Accenture, India 02/2018 - 09/2020

Contributed to monolith-to-microservices migration & modernization efforts, improving modularity and service scalability.

Optimized SQL queries and backend API logic, reducing data retrieval time by 40% and enhancing API performance by 25%.

Maintained 98% code reliability by executing 100+ unit tests using JUnit and Mockito, and documenting REST endpoints using Swagger/OpenAPI for easier client integration.

EDUCATION

MBA, ITSM

NMIMS

01/2021- 12/2023

B. Tech, CSE

Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University

08/2014 - 07/2018

SKILLS

Java

Spring Boot

Microservices

OOPS

Design Patterns

REST APIs / Web Services

SQL (Postgres, MySQL, etc.)

MongoDB

Data Structures & Algorithms

System Design

Maven

Git / GitHub

JUnit / Mockito

Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Jenkins

Docker

Swagger / Postman

Prometheus /Grafana / CloudWatch

Kafka

Confluence

INTERESTS

Reading & Travelling
